notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Vish Kal equal to the sacrificed creature's power
Repeat each turn.
